answer: What survives to the raven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Work waits on the nectar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ripple of the next round. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
